libretto.text: Seine Knie’ umwindend liegen wir Walküren, –
libretto.translation: Clasping his knees we Valkyries lie, –

libretto.text: blind bleibt er den flehenden Blicken:
libretto.translation: he remains blind to the pleading glances:

libretto.translation: timidity and endless fear consume us all. –
